name: BACKBONE Technology AG
summary: BACKBONE Technology AG, through its subsidiaries, provides data analysis, forensics, and cyber defense solutions in Europe. It offers forensic services for the identification and detection of illegal and reputation-damaging processes in data networks and the Internet. The company also develops and distributes solutions for the secure use and management of content in data networks and forensic technologies with artificial intelligence. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Hamburg, Germany.
